name: Laurel Plaza
summary: Laurel Plaza is a neighborhood business plaza in Salinas featuring a variety of offices and retail establishments, including the popular Collier Pet Supplies. With convenient hours and a practical mix of services, it serves as a reliable destination for everyday shopping needs in the local community.
demographics: Laurel Plaza serves the Salinas community, which has a diverse, predominantly Hispanic population with a strong agricultural workforce base. The trade area attracts middle-income families and working professionals seeking convenient shopping for everyday needs and services. Typical visitors include local residents shopping for pet supplies, professional services, and routine errands, with a practical, value-conscious shopping orientation reflective of Salinas' agricultural economy and family-oriented demographic profile.
description: Laurel Plaza is a convenient neighborhood shopping center located at 21 West Laurel Drive in Salinas, California, serving the local community with a variety of essential services and retail options. This business plaza features a well-stocked Collier Pet Supplies, known for its excellent customer service and comprehensive inventory for pet owners throughout the area. The center provides a practical mix of offices and retail establishments that cater to the everyday needs of Salinas residents. With a solid 4.2-star rating from 83 reviews, visitors consistently appreciate the variety of businesses and the accessible location. Operating daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Laurel Plaza offers convenient hours for busy families and professionals seeking quality services in a straightforward, no-frills shopping environment.
